lens.label: GLA11-025-025-A plano-convex lens
lens.source_note: Manufacturer dimensions; plane face is oriented toward the beam splitter.

optical_layout.datum_policy: Catalog EFL is applied to the inward optical-axis surface vertex. The annular mechanical support plane is derived separately from the actual lens sag at the support radius. Manufacturer BFL is retained as a physical tuning datum for thick plano-convex lenses.

plano_face_orientation.A: plane face points +Z toward beam splitter
plano_face_orientation.B: plane face points -Z toward beam splitter
plano_face_orientation.C: plane face points -X toward beam splitter

central_c_source_style_fit.classification: preserved tight printed source interface, not a CAD clearance fit

a_input_receiver.classification: exact source OpenHI internal female receiver B-rep

optical_distance_chain.reference_plane_note: The inward optical-axis surface vertex is placed exactly one catalog EFL from the beam splitter. The annular holder seat is offset by the lens sag at its support radius, and the finite lens thickness is contained inside the fully inserted holder/cap cavity rather than added again to the 2f/4f arm distance. This surface vertex is not a certified thick-lens principal plane.

A.print_orientation: preserve assembly orientation; translate minimum Z to build plate

B.print_orientation: preserve assembly orientation; translate minimum Z to build plate

C.print_orientation: rotate -90 degrees about Y; lens-retainer end on build plate

Lens_B_holder.print_orientation: rotate 180 degrees about Y; outer lens-retainer end on build plate

Lens_C_holder.print_orientation: rotate -90 degrees about Y; broad central mating end on build plate
